mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sq_operation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PREPARED', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'IN_FLIGHT', 'UNKNOWN', 'RECONCILING')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sq_sandbox_execution x JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = x.user_id AND s.scope_id = x.scope_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.kind = 'TASK' AND s.owner_id = #{taskId} AND x.status IN ('IN_FLIGHT', 'UNKNOWN')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'OPEN')

SELECT b.user_id, b.task_id, b.binding_id, t.status AS task_status, t.plan_version, t.answer_revision, t.proposal_turn_id, t.proposal_hash, t.proposal_tool_call_id, t.completion_proposal_json, (t.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancellation_requested FROM sq_runtime_binding b JOIN sq_goal_task t ON t.user_id = b.user_id AND t.task_id = b.task_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.framework_session_id = #{sessionId} AND b.role = 'MASTER' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_goal_task SET completion_proposal_json = #{proposalJson}, proposal_binding_id = #{bindingId}, proposal_turn_id = #{turnId}, proposal_tool_call_id = #{toolCallId}, proposal_hash = #{proposalHash}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND completion_proposal_json IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, task_id, conversation_id, status, version, plan_version, answer_revision, proposal_binding_id, proposal_turn_id, completion_proposal_json, completion_correction_count, (cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancellation_requested FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = #{outcome}, answer_revision = answer_revision + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND proposal_binding_id = #{bindingId} AND proposal_turn_id = #{turnId} AND completion_proposal_json IS NOT NULL AND plan_version = #{planVersion} AND answer_revision = #{answerRevision} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_operation o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.task_id = #{taskId} AND o.status IN ('PREPARED', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'IN_FLIGHT', 'UNKNOWN', 'RECONCILING')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_sandbox_execution x JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = x.user_id AND s.scope_id = x.scope_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.kind = 'TASK' AND s.owner_id = #{taskId} AND x.status IN ('IN_FLIGHT', 'UNKNOWN')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_interaction i WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.task_id = #{taskId} AND i.status = 'OPEN')

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET completion_correction_count = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND completion_correction_count = 0 AND completion_proposal_json IS NULL AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'FAILED', answer_revision = answer_revision + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND completion_correction_count = 1 AND completion_proposal_json IS NULL AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'RECOVERY_BLOCKED', blocked_reason = #{reason}, completion_proposal_json = NULL, proposal_binding_id = NULL, proposal_turn_id = NULL, proposal_tool_call_id = NULL, proposal_hash = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = #{status}, blocked_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'RUNNING', blocked_reason = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('WAITING_APPROVAL', 'WAITING_INPUT') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL
